## EPIC GAME LAUNCHER与UNREAL ENGINE

### 于该网址下载

[Epic Games Store | Download & Play PC Games, Mods, DLC & More – Epic Games](https://store.epicgames.com/?lang=en-US)

![image-20260906213725553](./assets/image-20260906213725553-1788857014572-3-1788857197758-105.png)

![image-20260906214353193](./assets/image-20260906214353193-1788857014572-7-1788857197758-109.png)

![image-20260906225342825](./assets/image-20260906225342825-1788857014572-11-1788857197759-113.png)

![image-20260906225505600](./assets/image-20260906225505600-1788857014572-13-1788857197759-114.png)

![image-20260906225615178](./assets/image-20260906225615178-1788857014572-15-1788857197759-117.png)

### 进入界面，若弹出该界面，则点击RESTART AND UPDATE，并耐心等待

![image-20260906230151424](./assets/image-20260906230151424-1788857014572-16-1788857197759-118.png)

### 正常界面如下，点击虚幻引擎，点击库，点击引擎版本右侧加号

### 即可创建新的虚幻引擎，点击虚幻引擎上的数字可以选择版本

### 注意，版本要求使用4.27.2，较新的版本需要另一套airsim

![image-20260906231221582](./assets/image-20260906231221582-1788857014572-18-1788857197759-119.png)

![image-20260906230424242](./assets/image-20260906230424242-1788857014572-19-1788857197759-121.png)

![image-20260906230627196](./assets/image-20260906230627196-1788857014572-21-1788857197760-122.png)

## Visual Studio

### ~~通过该网站下载[Visual Studio IDE - 用于编码调试和测试的 AI](https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/zh-hans/vs/)~~

### ~~点击下载Visual Studio,选择Community~~

### 点击即可下载https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vs_Community.exe

### 双击安装，继续，耐心等待

![image-20260906231741787](./assets/image-20260906231741787-1788857014573-25-1788857197760-126.png)

### 安装界面如下，注意更改安装位置，节省空间

![image-20260906235713310](./assets/image-20260906235713310-1788857014573-28-1788857197760-127.png)

### 需要如下组件![image-20260907005547951](./assets/image-20260907005547951-1788857014573-27-1788857197760-129.png)

![image-20260907012801224](./assets/image-20260907012801224-1788857014573-26-1788857197760-131.png)



### 还需要win10的sdk以用来编译，从以下网站下滑找到Windows10，点击installer下载，

[Windows SDK downloads - Windows apps | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/apps/windows-sdk/downloads)

![image-20260907011836693](./assets/image-20260907011836693-1788857014573-29-1788857197760-133.png)

![image-20260907012909833](./assets/image-20260907012909833-1788857014573-30-1788857197760-130.png)

![image-20260907012935807](./assets/image-20260907012935807-1788857014573-31-1788857197760-132.png)

![image-20260907012947201](./assets/image-20260907012947201-1788857014573-32-1788857197761-134.png)

![image-20260907013038901](./assets/image-20260907013038901-1788857014573-34-1788857197761-135.png)
